Orlando's thin frontcourt points toward more rebounds. This is the same exposure as the PRA under.","model_case":"With about 33.5 projected minutes, expected volume edges past the line. The under case rests on skew, not a lower mean. Rebounds make up a large share of this total and are the most exposed to Orlando's forward absences.","price_case":"Main line 33.5 at +105 needs about 48.8 in 100 to break even. The model and the single other book are close together and only modestly above that. That would undercut an under whose mean projection is already above the line.","kind":"injury","direction":"concern","represented_in":"unknown"}]},{"candidate_id":"dcc220e9ad9590ac92e993d0","status":"concern","assessment":{"verdict":"consider","reason":"The projection (22.52 mean, 21 median) sits below 23.5. The +110 price beats a four-book market near even, so price and model point the same way. Teammate absences are the main risk.","model_case":"About 33.9 projected minutes produce a mean roughly a point under the line. The model does not adjust for teammates' absences. Long-standing Jazz absences may already sit in the rolling rates, but the newer Nurkic absence may not.","price_case":"Main line 23.5 at +110 needs about 47.6 in 100 to break even. Four other books make the under roughly even. The model's lean further toward the under is a moderate gap, not an extreme one.","context_case":"Utah's listed absences could keep George's usage high, and Dallas's listed center absence may soften rim protection. Both cut against the under. The Kyrie Irving trade-rumor article is not relevant to this prop.","blocking_checks":[]},"countercase":"With Utah's frontcourt depleted and Dallas missing its starting center, George could take on more shots and finish efficiently at the rim. A single hot shooting night clears 23.5 easily.","open_checks":["Confirm George is active with no restriction near tipoff.","Recheck that +110 at 23.5 is still available.","Note whether PJ Washington returns for Dallas, since his listed absence runs only through Nov 22."],"evidence":[{"source_id":"331ea6b8f6fa8f848de4","excerpt":"Lauri Markkanen (PF); Hand; Expected to be out","interpretation":"If Markkanen remains out, George's shot volume may stay elevated. Because the model does not adjust for teammate absences, it may understate that usage unless the rolling sample already captures it.","kind":"injury","direction":"concern","represented_in":"unknown"},{"source_id":"331ea6b8f6fa8f848de4","excerpt":"Dereck Lively II (C); Foot; Expected to be out","interpretation":"If Lively sits, Dallas's weaker interior defense could help George score efficiently.","kind":"injury","direction":"concern","represented_in":"unknown"}]}]}
